title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1987-09-15
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transfer by Andrew F. 09/2011
source: 24bit/48kHz file set: OTS AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300 w/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX90's, w/no Dolby. Taped by Ted Gidley.

ai_review.summary: Outstanding audience recording captures a great 1987 MSG show with immersive sound despite a occasional bass‑mix dip.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the AUD source, calling it the best audience tape of this run and praising its immersive, almost现场 presence. The performance itself is described as a "great show," though one reviewer notes Phil's bass can get a tad lost in the mix at times. Overall the recording is crystal‑clear and enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 5 stars, highlighting excellent sound quality and a strong performance; minor mix issues keep it from a perfect score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Immersive, clear audio with great presence; occasional moment where Phil's bass is slightly lost in the mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers did not comment on specific set structure but uniformly describe the show as great.

band_member_comments.Phil: Gets a tad lost in the mix occasionally.
